Use case: stylized-concept.
Create a finished landscape 3:2 desktop wallpaper for a Ram Dass Be Here Now inspired Omarchy theme. Original psychedelic 1970s screenprinted spiritual poster art, intricate hand-inked guilloche, warm analog paper texture, not a photograph, not a mockup.
A very large mesmerizing circular mandala centered on a deep aubergine-violet field, nested lotus petals and interwoven fine golden lines with subtle impossible looping depth, concentric waves flowing outward, tiny celestial dots. Big expressive but clearly legible cream serif lettering reading exactly "BE HERE NOW" integrated in an arc above the mandala. The mandala fills about 75 percent of the image height; keep its outer edges intact and the top 6 percent quiet for a desktop bar. A small empty wooden chair at its heart. Trippy, contemplative, luminous, detailed but not glaring. Palette deep ink plum #191421, violet #49365F, lavender #B49AD8, parchment #EADCC3, saffron #DDB568 with sparse muted coral and sage. Edge regions fade to deep plum. No additional words, no signature, no watermark, no app windows. Request a high-resolution landscape 3:2 image.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create one finished 3:2 landscape desktop wallpaper, an original psychedelic 1970s spiritual screenprint illustration for a Ram Dass Be Here Now inspired computer theme.
Main subject: a charming VERY SIMPLE stick figure, round empty head and thin expressive line limbs, seated cross-legged in LOTUS POSITION on a small cushion, calmly typing at a retro computer terminal on a low desk. Clearly recognizable stick figure, not a realistically rendered human. Show the figure and CRT terminal in three-quarter side view, in the lower middle of the composition. Only one figure and one computer. A small luminous terminal prompt ">_" on the screen.
Behind them: a HUGE intricate circular mandala taking up most of the canvas height, with interwoven gold lines, radiating lotus petals, concentric ripples and subtle impossible geometry. Big, beautifully drawn and clearly legible words exactly "BE HERE NOW" across an arc above the mandala. The scene feels gently funny, mindful, trippy and welcoming. Fine hand-inked engraving, uneven screenprint ink, vintage paper grain. Deep plum #191421 and rich violet #49365F background, parchment #EADCC3 and saffron #DDB568 lines, lavender, restrained coral and sage. The stick figure and terminal must remain clearly legible against a quiet center of the mandala; dense ornate detail around the perimeter. Whole mandala fits in frame. Leave top 6 percent dark and clear for desktop bar, no frame, no signatures, no extra text except BE HERE NOW and >_. This is the wallpaper artwork itself, no screen mockup. High resolution, landscape aspect ratio 3:2.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create one original 3:2 landscape desktop wallpaper: a trippy, warm vintage spiritual poster with a large mandala and the exact words "BE HERE NOW".
Main subject: a whimsical LOTUS STICK FIGURE at an old computer terminal. The person is literally drawn as a lotus: small lotus blossom for a head, a few delicate stem-like lines for torso and arms, petal-shaped folded legs, hands gently at a keyboard. Keep it sparse and iconic like an old hand-drawn spiritual book illustration, not a realistic person and not a robot. One lotus figure, one chunky CRT computer with a tiny glowing ">_" terminal prompt, on a simple low wooden desk in side view. This central little scene sits in the open center of an enormous hypnotic mandala of many scalloped petal rings, fluid concentric contour lines and ornate radial geometry. Large readable "BE HERE NOW" lettering flows around the upper arc.
Style: 1970s psychedelic ink drawing and woodcut, light imperfect analog print texture, intricate but beautiful and calm, warm parchment linework on deep violet-black. Palette #191421 plum, #49365F purple, #B49AD8 lavender, #EADCC3 paper, #DDB568 gold, sparse muted magenta and turquoise. More surreal than a conventional lotus illustration: petal rings subtly become flowing waves, gentle optical rhythm, cosmic depth. Dark margin and entire mandala within canvas, top six percent clear for desktop bar. High-resolution 3:2 landscape, no watermark, no other words, no modern app UI, no photo mockup.
